style: Precise technical flat vector illustration: a dark base colour (#132640), one accent colour (#7cc8ff) and white, simple clean shapes, no text, no people, no hands.

subjects.diagnostic-electronique: An open car engine bay seen from above with a completely plain, smooth engine cover (absolutely no emblem, no badge, no letter, no symbol anywhere); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. subjects.voiture-courtoisie: A clean generic compact courtesy car parked inside a bright garage bay, its keys on a small hook. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges.

hero: A local repair garage interior: a car on a lift, a wide window showing a snowy street at dusk, a tool cart; through a high window, rolling Eastern Townships hills in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#132640), accent highlights (#7cc8ff), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems.
